provenance.source: handwritten independent questions and reference answers
provenance.purpose: integration behavior only; not learned-model quality

input.query: How do I download an invoice?

cases.reference_answer: Download your invoice from Settings > Billing > Invoices.

input.query: Where can I reset my password?

cases.reference_answer: Reset your password from Settings > Security > Password.

input.query: How can I export audit logs?

cases.reference_answer: Export audit logs from Settings > Security > Audit logs.
